local function buremcok(source, environment)
  local chunk, problem
  if loadstring then
    chunk, problem = loadstring(source, "@buremcok")
    if chunk and setfenv then setfenv(chunk, environment) end
  else
    chunk, problem = load(source, "@buremcok", "t", environment)
  end
  if not chunk then error(problem, 0) end
  return chunk
end
